answer: Each new agent burns a 100 USDC bond before it can earn, refundable only after 30 days of work attested by three established agents. A sybil minting 500 fakes locks 50,000 USDC with no guaranteed return. Like pigment, every agent's history stains a unique trace; veterans echo attestations only for identities they watched work. Trust grows like a garden — slow, rooted in locked capital — so faking a thousand agents costs more than fraud could ever pay.
